title: Primary Bathroom with Freestanding Tub and Stone Accent Wall
scope: Primary bathroom with a freestanding tub, walk-in glass shower and double vanity
materials: Marble-look porcelain tile, stacked stone accent wall, navy double vanity, matte black fixtures, frameless glass
summary: A long primary bathroom finished floor to ceiling in marble-look tile, with a freestanding tub under a stacked stone window wall.
description:
This Palatine primary bathroom runs the length of the room: a freestanding tub sits under the window against a stacked stone accent wall, a navy double vanity with two backlit mirrors lines one side, and a frameless glass walk-in shower with a pebble mosaic floor and recessed niche closes the other end.

Large marble-look porcelain covers the walls and floor, and matte black faucets, shower controls and hardware tie the room together. A wall-mounted TV and a smart toilet round out the space.

title: Bathroom with Double Rain Shower and Brushed Gold Fixtures
scope: Bathroom with a two-person shower, two benches and brushed gold fixtures
materials: Marble-look porcelain walls, slate-look floor tile, brushed gold fixtures, navy vanity, heated towel rack
summary: A large walk-in shower with two rain heads, two floating benches and brushed gold fixtures.
description:
The shower in this Kildeer bathroom is built for two: two ceiling rain heads, two slide-bar handshowers, two sets of controls and a floating bench at each end, all in marble-look porcelain over a slate-look floor.

Brushed gold fixtures carry through to the heated towel rack and the navy vanity hardware, and a backlit mirror and recessed niche finish the room.

title: Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Textured Accent Tile
scope: Bathroom with a walk-in shower, half wall and double vanity with a center tower
materials: Textured gray accent tile, wood-look floor tile, matte black fixtures, gray shaker double vanity
summary: A walk-in shower behind a half wall, with a textured gray accent wall and a double vanity with a center storage tower.
description:
This Rolling Meadows bathroom has a walk-in shower set behind a tiled half wall, with a textured gray accent wall, a two-shelf niche, a linear drain and matte black rain head and handshower.

Across the room, a gray shaker double vanity with a center storage tower, two framed mirrors and sconces sits on the same wood-look floor tile that runs into the shower.

title: Two Bathrooms with Subway Tile and Marble-Look Floors
scope: Two bathrooms in one home: a tub bath and a walk-in shower bath
materials: White subway tile, marble-look hexagon floor tile, marble mosaic shower floor, quartz-look vanity tops, chrome fixtures
summary: Two bathrooms in the same Evanston home, one with a tub and white double vanity, one with a glass walk-in shower and charcoal double vanity.
description:
We remodeled two bathrooms in this Evanston home. The first has a tiled tub-shower with a recessed niche, subway tile wainscot and a white double vanity under a wide mirror.

The second trades the tub for a frameless glass walk-in shower with a marble mosaic floor, recessed niche and corner shelf, paired with a charcoal double vanity. Both rooms share the same marble-look hexagon floor tile and chrome fixtures.

title: Bathroom with Wood-Look Tile Walk-In Shower
scope: Bathroom with a walk-in shower, floating vanity and wood-look plank tile
materials: Wood-look plank tile, light porcelain wall tile, floating black vanity, matte black fixtures, LED medicine cabinet
summary: A walk-in shower with a wood-look tile feature wall that carries across the floor, with a floating black vanity.
description:
Wood-look plank tile runs up the back wall of the walk-in shower in this Streamwood bathroom and continues across the floor, set against light porcelain on the other walls.

A floating black vanity, a lighted medicine cabinet, matte black fixtures and a frosted glass door finish the room.

title: Open Kitchen with Waterfall Island and Floating Ceiling Panel
scope: Open kitchen with a waterfall island, plus a new staircase railing and treads
materials: Dark textured cabinets, white waterfall island top, marble-look slab accents, hickory-look wood floors, black metal stair railing
summary: A dark-cabinet kitchen open to the living and dining room, centered on a waterfall island under a lit floating ceiling panel.
description:
This Lake Zurich kitchen opens to the dining and living room. Dark textured cabinets wrap the walls and the island, which has a white waterfall top and seating on the stair side. Overhead, a floating ceiling panel with hidden lighting holds two lantern pendants.

Marble-look slabs frame the cooking wall, and the stairs next to the kitchen got new light treads and a black horizontal-bar railing that matches the kitchen.

title: Bathroom and Powder Room with Lit Niches
scope: A full bathroom and a powder room, both with built-in lighting
materials: Marble-look large-format porcelain, LED strip lighting, gold vessel sink, sculpted textured wall, frameless glass
summary: A marble-look shower with LED-lit niches, and a powder room with a sculpted feature wall and gold vessel sink.
description:
In this Lake Zurich home, the shower is wrapped in large marble-look porcelain with a long LED-lit niche and a lit soffit, behind frameless glass. A recessed toilet alcove has lit floating shelves above.

The powder room has a sculpted, textured feature wall that curves around a large mirror, a gold vessel sink on a marble-look counter and a cluster of glass pendants.

title: Bathroom with Black Marble-Look Floor and Glass Tub Panel
scope: Bathroom with a tub-shower, glass panel and wood vanity
materials: White marble-look wall tile, black marble-look floor tile, matte black fixtures, wood vanity, glass tub panel
summary: White marble-look walls over a black marble-look floor, with a tub-shower behind a glass panel and matte black fixtures.
description:
This Lake Zurich bathroom pairs white marble-look wall tile with a black marble-look floor. The tub-shower has a glass panel, a recessed niche and matte black rain head, handshower and controls.

A wood vanity with a white top, a lighted mirror and matte black accessories finish the room.

title: Primary Bathroom with Brass Fixtures and Kitchen Range Hood
scope: Primary bathroom shower and a kitchen range hood wall
materials: Marble-look porcelain, pearl mosaic accent tile, brushed brass fixtures, frameless glass, custom range hood with metal band
summary: A marble-look walk-in shower with brushed brass fixtures and a floating bench, plus a custom range hood in the kitchen.
description:
This Chicago primary bathroom has a walk-in shower in marble-look porcelain behind frameless glass, with brushed brass fixtures, a floating bench, a recessed niche, a shimmering mosaic accent wall and a linear drain.

In the same home, the kitchen cooking wall has a custom tapered range hood with a metal band, framed by marble-look backsplash and white cabinetry.

title: Three Bathrooms: Freestanding Tub, Fluted Tile Shower and Bench Shower
materials: Marble-look porcelain, fluted wood-tone tile, hex mosaic floor, frameless glass, matte black and chrome fixtures
summary: Three bathrooms in one home: a primary bath with a freestanding tub, a fluted-tile shower, and a shower with a quartz-look bench.
description:
The primary bathroom in this home has a freestanding tub under a wide window and a frameless glass shower with a tiled bench, all in marble-look porcelain.

A second bathroom has a walk-in shower lined in fluted wood-tone tile with matte black fixtures, and a third has a white tile shower with a bench and hex mosaic floor.

title: Loft Kitchen Island and Three Bathrooms
scope: Loft kitchen island and cabinetry, primary bathroom, hall bathroom and powder room
materials: White shaker cabinets, quartz-look tops, marble-look porcelain, octagon mosaic accent wall, frameless glass, glass tile floor
summary: A loft kitchen with a long cooktop island, plus a primary bath with a freestanding tub, a hall bath and a powder room.
description:
In this Chicago loft we built a long island with a cooktop and sink, white shaker cabinetry with paneled refrigerator and wall ovens, and a dark end panel that matches the steel beams.

The primary bathroom has a freestanding tub against an octagon mosaic accent wall, a frameless glass shower with a bench and linear drain, and a floating vanity, all over large marble-look porcelain. We also redid the hall bath with a tub-shower and the powder room, which has a wall-mounted sink over a multicolor glass tile floor.

title: Living Room Built-Ins with Floating Shelves
scope: Built-in media wall with base cabinets and floating shelves
materials: Flat-panel painted cabinets, white stone-look top, stained wood floating shelves
summary: A built-in media wall with flat-panel base cabinets, a recessed TV and stained wood floating shelves.
description: This Glencoe living room got a built-in media wall: a recessed TV centered between two shelf alcoves with stained wood floating shelves, over a long run of flat-panel base cabinets with a white top.

title: Kitchen and Two Bathroom Showers in Progress
scope: Kitchen cabinetry and two tiled showers
materials: Gray wood-grain cabinets, stainless appliances, porcelain shower tile, pebble and hexagon floor tile
summary: Gray wood-grain kitchen cabinets going in, and two newly tiled showers.
description: These photos are from partway through a Mundelein remodel: gray wood-grain kitchen cabinets and stainless appliances installed under a vaulted ceiling, and two tiled showers, one with a charcoal accent wall and pebble floor, the other in glossy green-gray tile over a hexagon floor.

title: Calacatta Kitchen with Walnut Island
scope: Removed the wall between kitchen and family room, new layout with a 10-foot walnut island, full-height Calacatta quartz backsplash, paneled appliances.
materials: Calacatta quartz, rift-cut walnut, brushed brass hardware, wide-plank white oak
summary: A closed 1970s kitchen opened to the family room, centered on a 10-foot walnut island.
description: This Palatine kitchen was closed off from the family room by a load-bearing wall. We replaced the wall with a flush beam, moved the sink to a new 10-foot walnut island, and ran Calacatta quartz from the counters up the full backsplash. Paneled refrigerator and dishwasher keep the cabinet run clean, and brushed brass hardware ties the island to the lighting. The project was permitted through the Village of Palatine and took 8 weeks on site.

title: Primary Bath with Green Zellige Shower
scope: Tub removed for a curbless walk-in shower, heated floor, double vanity.
materials: Handmade zellige tile, terrazzo floor, Schluter waterproofing
summary: Tub out, curbless zellige shower in, with a heated terrazzo-look floor.
description: The owners wanted the dated tub and fiberglass surround gone. We recessed the subfloor for a curbless shower, waterproofed with Schluter Kerdi, and tiled the walls in handmade green zellige. A heated floor and a 72-inch double vanity finished the room in 4 weeks.

title: Nero Marble Powder Room
scope: Floating stone vanity, wall-mounted faucet, full-height marble wall.
materials: Nero marble, plaster walls, brass fixtures
summary: A small room made dramatic with a full-height Nero marble wall.
description: A two-week powder room remodel in Inverness built around one full-height wall of Nero marble, a floating stone vanity and a wall-mounted brass faucet.

title: Terrazzo Hall Bath
scope: New tub and tile surround, terrazzo floor, new vanity and lighting.
materials: Terrazzo porcelain, white ceramic wall tile
summary: A kids' hall bath rebuilt for durability with terrazzo tile.
description: A hard-working hall bath rebuilt with terrazzo porcelain floors, a new cast iron tub and an easy-clean tile surround.

title: Basement with Walnut Wet Bar
scope: Full basement finish with wet bar, media wall and egress window.
summary: An unfinished basement turned into a media room with a walnut wet bar.
description: A full basement finish with framing, insulation, an egress window, a walnut wet bar and a media wall.

title: Plaster Hood White Kitchen
scope: New cabinets, plaster range hood, quartz counters, new lighting plan.
materials: Venetian plaster, quartz, painted maple cabinets
summary: A bright kitchen refresh anchored by a custom plaster range hood.
description: New painted cabinetry, a custom plaster range hood and a new lighting plan in a 6-week Rolling Meadows kitchen remodel.
